observations.actual:
Harness native checks (Debug)
ok   an https origin of another machine is a relay
ok   plain http, a path, user information and this device are refused
ok   Debug without the opt-in refuses a local relay
ok   Debug with the opt-in accepts plain http on this machine only
ok   the opt-in never accepts plain http of another machine
ok   the socket address holds no credential
ok   a pairing link with its three public fields is handed on as it is
ok   a link with a code, another target or a missing field is not a pairing link
ok   a paired phone is connecting until the computer attached it
ok   nothing may be asked before a computer attached this phone
ok   the attach answer makes the computer online
ok   only attached device methods are offered, never a desktop one
ok   a lock state the computer reported is stated
ok   a method that was not attached is refused and never sent
ok   a Debug build that was not started for a fixture does not say it is one
ok   a Debug build started for a fixture says so in its status
ok   the status holds no credential
ok   a lock state the computer did not report stays unknown
ok   a locked computer stays online
ok   an unlocked computer is stated as unlocked
ok   a computer going to sleep is offline and has no lock state
ok   a lost link is offline at once
ok   a new link replaces the lost one
ok   a callback of the old link restores nothing and sends nothing
ok   an event of the old link is not handed to the page
ok   a late revocation of the old link does not wipe the pairing
ok   after a disconnect an old callback changes nothing and opens nothing
ok   after a disconnect nothing is kept and nothing is delivered
ok   an answered read is kept while the pairing holds
ok   socket closed as unauthorized: the phone says its access was removed
ok   socket closed as unauthorized: the credential and keys leave the vault
ok   socket closed as unauthorized: every saved copy is purged
ok   socket closed as unauthorized: nothing is offered any more
